name: Gage County Republican Party
history: The Gage County Republican Party was re-established in 2022. Members attended the state convention, organized a fair booth, and took part in parades and other local activities.
A November 2023 fundraiser helped build connections and support the party’s mission. The county party held a convention in March 2024 and elected its executive officers.
In 2024, the party participated in the Homestead Parade and Czech Days Parade, held a dunk booth at the Gage County Fair, and gathered for an election-night celebration.
